categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp` and `src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp` to fix state caching behavior across calls in the C API.
categories.rationale: Prevents severe validation correctness bugs where an invalid block falsely passes verification under different consensus parameters if checked previously. The description notes that a regtest block checked under regtest params subsequently passes mainnet checks, and signet blocks can bypass challenge verification across chainstate managers.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label, changes are confined entirely to the libbitcoinkernel C API boundary in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp` without altering internal validation logic, which the category definition explicitly excludes.
categories.rationale: Excluded per the validation category definition, which specifies that PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API belong to kernel rather than validation.
